about: Trigger tests for the skill description: prompts that should and should not activate pro-video-editor. Run them through the skill-creator description optimizer or by hand after any change to the SKILL.md description.
should_trigger: Edit these clips into a 30 second YouTube Short with captions
I have 40 minutes of podcast footage from two cameras, cut it into a full episode and 5 clips
Turn my vlog footage from Lalibela into a 10 minute video with music
Here are reference videos from an editor I like, learn their style and edit my talking head like that
Make this interview into a documentary-style piece with lower thirds
Cut the dead air and filler words out of this recording and add captions
Add Amharic captions to this video and export SRT
Can you make this product footage into a 20 second Reels ad?
Edit this video, make it more engaging for TikTok
Export my edit as a timeline I can open in DaVinci Resolve
This cut is too slow in the middle, make it punchier
Score this edit for retention and tell me what to fix
Color correct and match these shots, then grade warm
Analyse these 10 reference shorts and tell me their pacing, caption style and SFX density
should_not_trigger: Generate a video of a cat surfing from this prompt
Write a script for a YouTube video about budgeting
Make me a thumbnail image in the MrBeast style
What's the best camera for vlogging under $500?
Build a React video player component
Make an animated explainer from scratch with no footage
Transcribe this audio file to text
Compress this video so it's under 25 MB
notes: Borderline by design: 'Transcribe this audio' and 'compress this video' are single FFmpeg/Whisper tasks, not editing; the skill should not load for them.
'Make an animated explainer from scratch' is generation from nothing, which the description excludes.
